source_en: Heads or tails? Habit. Bidzina Chkhonia. Cards, mostly.
I've been timing this checkpoint. The variance is bigger than you'd think.
Probability needs data. You're one of my steadier variables.
The Metropol, before it closed. Now a basement. Lower stakes.
You have a tell, officer. I won't say [[whisper:which eye]]. But I'd bet on it.
Everybody has tells. Twenty years reading them. It's data, not an insult.
More than the cards. Cards are mathematics. People are the game.
Heads. Always heads lately. That worries me.
